texts.preamble: Ram Chandra vs State Of U.P. on 11 September, 2019 Author: Sudhir Agarwal Bench: Sudhir Agarwal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 34 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 1255 of 1997 Revisionist :- Ram Chandra Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Counsel for Revisionist :- A.K.Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J. 1.
texts.facts: This revision has been filed challenging both the aforesaid orders.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for revisionist confined his argument by only stating that considering advanced age of revisionist and taking lenient view, punishment of imprisonment may be reduced to the period already undergone. On the contrary, I find that minimum punishment prescribed under Statute has been awarded, and hence the same cannot be reduced as held by Apex Court recent in State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Vikram Das (2019) 4 SCC 125 observing as under: ??
